top: Each row links an organization to a service and its associated GTFS datasets (schedule, service alerts, vehicle positions, trip updates). Use this table to join organizations, services, and GTFS datas
Each row represents a transit service in the Cal-ITP Transit Database.
Each row represents a organization in the Cal-ITP Transit Database.  These organizations may or not be a transit agency.
Each row is a cleaned row from a trips.txt file. Definitions for the original GTFS fields are available at: https://gtfs.org/reference/static#tripstxt.

Each row is a cleaned row from a shapes.txt file. Definitions for the original GTFS fields are available at: https://gtfs.org/reference/static#shapestxt.
Each row is a cleaned row from a routes.txt file. Definitions for the original GTFS fields are available at: https://gtfs.org/reference/static#routestxt.
